name: SyncTec
author: bestever255

sections.description:
Multi-store, multi-location sync — perfectly mastered. Keep your WooCommerce and Shopify stores in perfect harmony.

SyncTec connects your WooCommerce store with your Shopify stores and automates your entire e-commerce network in real time. Easily sync inventory, products, orders and collections across all your storefronts — whether they run on WooCommerce, Shopify, or both.

Our advanced multi-location support lets you map specific warehouses and fulfillment centers to individual stores. Eliminate manual errors, prevent overselling, and scale your business effortlessly.

Why merchants use SyncTec

  • Multi-location sync — real-time stock adjustment matched by SKU, so every store always shows the right quantity.
  • Product import & sync — bring products over with all their fields and metafields, and keep them updated.
  • Order push & mirror — orders are pushed and mirrored to your source store for easier fulfillment.
  • WooCommerce ⇄ Shopify — run both platforms side by side without copying anything by hand.
  • Manage on the go — the SyncTec dashboard is fully mobile and tablet responsive.

Get started in minutes

Install the plugin, click Continue to SyncTec, sign in, and click Connect WooCommerce. That’s it — SyncTec takes it from there. All syncing runs on SyncTec’s servers, so your WordPress site stays fast.

External services

This plugin connects this site to SyncTec (https://synctec.io), a separate multistore inventory sync service, so that product, inventory, and order data can be synchronised between this WooCommerce store and the merchant’s Shopify store(s). This connection is not optional — it is this plugin’s entire purpose — but nothing is sent until the merchant explicitly clicks Continue to SyncTec or Connect WooCommerce in the SyncTec screen under wp-admin.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you click Continue to SyncTec, this site’s domain and site title are sent to SyncTec’s application, so you can register or log in and be redirected back here. https://app.synctec.io
  • When you click Connect WooCommerce, a WooCommerce REST API consumer key and secret (generated locally by this plugin) are sent to SyncTec’s API, so SyncTec’s servers can read and write products, inventory, and orders on this store. https://api.synctec.io
  • When you click Disconnect, or on uninstall, this site notifies SyncTec so it can deregister the connection on its side.

No data is sent automatically in the background, and no data is sent before you take one of the actions above.

SyncTec’s Terms of Use: https://synctec.io/terms
SyncTec’s Privacy Policy: https://synctec.io/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must already be active).
  2. Go to SyncTec in the wp-admin menu.
  3. Click Continue to SyncTec — you’ll register or log in, and join your team, on the SyncTec web application, then be redirected right back here.
  4. Click Connect WooCommerce to generate and send this store’s API credentials.
sections.changelog:
1.9.3

  • First release on WordPress.org.

1.2.0

  • Team joining moved to the SyncTec web application. The plugin no longer polls or refreshes live status — it only tracks whether it has sent a WooCommerce API key.

1.1.0

  • Registration/login moved to the SyncTec web application — this plugin now redirects there and back instead of hosting its own forms.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: registration/login, team join, WooCommerce connect.
